projects.title: DataCamp Student Club Platform
projects.summary: Production-grade educational web portal empowering university AI & Data Science students with an in-browser WebAssembly Python compiler, live Google Gemini AI mentor, and interactive learning tracks.

details.challenge: University students exploring AI and data science often encounter complex local Python setup hurdles, lack instant code feedback, and need bilingual guidance aligned with their university curriculum.
details.solution: Built a comprehensive web platform for the DataCamp Student Club at Innovation University. Features a client-side WebAssembly Python sandbox (Pyodide), the NEXUS AI bilingual mentor powered by Google Gemini with live Firestore context, and gamified student progress milestones.
impact: Eliminated local setup friction for new club members entering data science
Delivered zero-latency Python code execution entirely in the browser
Adopted as the official student club operating portal at Innovation University

projects.title: CircuitSim Pro - Physics Simulator
projects.summary: Interactive Windows desktop physics simulation suite for modeling electrical circuits, evaluating real-time Ohm's law parameters, and plotting oscilloscope current signals.

details.challenge: Physical laboratory equipment is costly, fragile, and not always accessible to students studying electrical circuits and basic circuit physics.
details.solution: Developed CircuitSim Pro, an intuitive Windows desktop application providing a virtual sandbox where students can connect power sources, resistors, switches, and lamps while observing instant electrical responses.
impact: Enabled safe, interactive experimentation with electrical circuit parameters
Bridged theoretical Ohm's law equations with visual, real-time feedback
Demonstrated high performance and responsive desktop engineering in .NET 9

projects.title: SmartMall AI OS
projects.summary: Intelligent operating system architecture designed to automate commercial retail spaces with AI-driven inventory prediction, automated customer flow analysis, and smart workflows.

details.challenge: Commercial shopping centers operate on fragmented, manual systems that fail to anticipate shopper density, optimize inventory, or automate emergency and energy protocols.
details.solution: Designed SmartMall AI OS, an architectural concept and operational blueprint unifying sensory inputs, predictive machine learning pipelines, and automated facility event responders.
impact: Formulated end-to-end blueprint for smart commercial operations
Demonstrated deep cross-disciplinary knowledge spanning systems architecture and AI
Engineered scalable modular components ready for IoT and edge deployment

projects.title: AI Quest: Engineer Path
projects.summary: Gamified desktop application that transforms the journey of becoming an AI Engineer into an RPG learning adventure, covering 8 roadmap worlds from Python foundations to Agentic AI.

details.challenge: Self-learning modern AI Engineering is overwhelming and prone to tutorial hell without a clear, structured roadmap and tangible milestones.
details.solution: Created AI Quest, a local-first desktop application combining deep educational roadmaps with RPG gamification mechanics (XP, boss challenges, achievement badges, and leveling).
impact: Provided structured guidance for aspiring engineers to track AI milestones systematically
Turned tedious syllabus tracking into an engaging, gamified daily habit
Bridged Arabic-speaking learners with international cutting-edge AI engineering standards

projects.title: Base Calculator & Number Systems Converter
projects.summary: High-speed Windows desktop application for converting between Binary, Octal, Decimal, and Hexadecimal, featuring chained multi-operand arithmetic across mixed number systems.

details.challenge: Computer science students and systems engineers need fast, accurate multi-base arithmetic with transparent step-by-step validation during digital logic and assembly learning.
details.solution: Built a dedicated WPF .NET 9 desktop calculator allowing users to enter numbers in any base, perform chained calculations, and see results simultaneously across all four major bases.
impact: Accelerated verification of low-level numbering conversions for students
Delivered a fluid, keyboard-optimized desktop tool with instant calculation times
Reinforced core algorithms and desktop application fundamentals in C#

projects.title: Dino Game Pro
projects.summary: High-performance 60 FPS endless runner desktop game for Windows built natively in C# and WPF, featuring custom procedural obstacle generation and score tracking.

details.challenge: Demonstrating that WPF and .NET desktop frameworks can maintain smooth 60 FPS game-loop rendering and low-latency input handling without full game engines like Unity.
details.solution: Constructed a native Windows implementation of the classic endless runner, implementing custom collision detection, progressive speed curves, and persistent score storage.
impact: Demonstrated desktop animation and game loop capabilities in pure WPF
Delivered a fun, responsive desktop game with instant startup time
Strengthened understanding of frame pacing, memory allocation, and event handling in .NET
